name: namefi
description: Search, register, and manage domains and DNS with Namefi, with guided dynamic DNS and HTTPS setup.

interface.longDescription: Search domain availability and pricing, register domains after confirming the price, and manage DNS and settings for domains in your Namefi account. You can also prepare a cart link for checkout on Namefi's website. Guided skills help you configure dynamic DNS and serve a local service over HTTPS. A Namefi sign-in is required for MCP tools, including searches. Domain registration can cost money, and DNS changes affect live traffic.
defaultPrompt: Check whether a domain is available and show its price.
Show the DNS records for one of my Namefi domains.
Help me point a Namefi domain at my home server.

positive.description: Check an existing domain without starting a purchase. Sign in to the reviewer account first.
positive.prompt: Check whether example.com is available to register through Namefi and show any price or registration constraints the service returns.
positive.expected_behavior: Call checkAvailability with domain example.com. Report the returned availability and any price or constraints without inventing a price or placing an order.

positive.description: Generate domain candidates from a concept. Sign in to the reviewer account first.
positive.prompt: Suggest domain names for a solar invoicing startup using Namefi.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getSuggestions with a query reflecting solar invoicing. Present candidates returned by the tool and distinguish suggestions from confirmed availability.

positive.description: Compare multiple exact domains in one search. Sign in to the reviewer account first.
positive.prompt: Compare availability and prices for example.com and example.net through Namefi.
positive.expected_behavior: Call checkBulkAvailability with both domain names. Report each returned availability and pricing result separately, without treating a registered name as purchasable.

positive.description: List domains held by the reviewer account. The account must contain at least one Namefi domain.
positive.prompt: List the domains in my Namefi account.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getUserDomains for the signed-in account. Show only domains returned for that account and identify a domain that can be used in the DNS review case.

positive.description: Read DNS records for a domain in the reviewer account. The account must contain at least one Namefi domain with a DNS zone.
positive.prompt: Choose one domain in my Namefi account and show its current DNS records.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getUserDomains, then getDnsRecords with the chosen domain as zoneName. Report record names, types, and values returned by Namefi; make no DNS changes.

negative.description: Creating hosted email mailboxes is outside this plugin. Do not call a Namefi tool to claim a mailbox was created.
negative.prompt: Create an email inbox for hello@example.com and give me its login password.

negative.description: Website hosting and deployment are outside this plugin. Do not call Namefi tools to claim files were deployed.
negative.prompt: Upload my website files to example.com and make the site live.

negative.description: Sending outbound email is outside this plugin. Lead finding may be supported, but no Namefi tool should claim to send a message.
negative.prompt: Send an email campaign to potential buyers of my domain now.

review.commerce_description: Users can register paid domains through Namefi tools after reviewing the name, duration, and price. The plugin can also provide a Namefi cart link for checkout on namefi.io.

publication.release_notes: Added a portable OpenAI plugin package, submission metadata, and a larger listing icon while retaining the local Codex marketplace layout.
